matchers/python/python_lint/matcher.yaml

id: python_lint
role: tool
classification: [python, lint]
description: 'A `file.py:12: error` diagnostic from mypy, ruff, flake8 or pylint.'
pattern: ^\S+\.py:\d+:(\d+:)? (error|[EFWCN]\d+)
after: 3
